scope: File-level overinclusive search: category and timing may belong to different effects; excludes files with any summon SetOperationInfo even when a different effect omits it. Effect-level review required.

rows.review: Damage-Step Quick Effect negates; self-summon is non-chain procedure.
Battle trigger grants immunity; summon is a later Standby Phase delayed trigger, not Damage Step.
Galactica Token Summon trigger is registered with Station; no native Damage Step trigger test yet.
Registered Galactica battle trigger tested with actual Extra Deck summon and no-registry control; Link material adapter required.
